items.title: Question about reading public listings on Europe Tech Internships 2026 (personal final-year project)
items.description:
Hello Europe Tech Internships 2026 team,

I'm Manuchehr Qoriev, a computer science student. OmniLadders (https://omniladders.pages.dev) is my own personal final-year project, free and non-commercial, and not run by any university or organization. It helps students around the world find internships and graduate roles.

My script already reads your public job listings once a day and shows the title, organization, location, date and a link back to your page. Nothing is sold.

Could you tell me if this is OK with you, or what you would prefer? If you would rather I stop, tell me and I will stop it within a few days and remove your listings.

I can send the full technical details (every request, what is stored) if that is useful.

Thank you,
Manuchehr Qoriev
OmniLadders · omniladders@gmail.com · https://omniladders.pages.dev
